effects: The signer sends exactly `assets` EURCV to the vault, through transferFrom in ERC4626._deposit. This spends the signer's EURCV allowance to the vault by the same amount.

Newly minted sgfEURCV vault shares go to `receiver`. The number is computed when the transaction runs: assets × (totalSupply+10^offset)/(lastTotalAssets+1), rounded down after interest accrues. There is no minimum.
formats.shown: "Deposit" with the EURCV amount, the share ticker sgfEURCV and the address that receives the shares.

findings.title: deposit: the number of shares received is not shown and there is no minimum.
findings.evidence: MetaMorphoV1_1.sol deposit(): shares = _convertToSharesWithTotals(assets, totalSupply(), lastTotalAssets, Floor). The rate comes from storage, and the function takes no minShares. Case 0: 1e18 sgfEURCV arrived at the signer, and the screen shows only the 'Share ticker: sgfEURCV'.
findings.fix: No descriptor fix. The amount comes from storage at execution time.

findings.title: deposit: spending the signer's existing EURCV allowance to the vault is not mentioned.
findings.evidence: Case 0 has an approval effect with signer 'grant': EURCV allowance from signer to vault set to 9e18. This is the remaining allowance after transferFrom spent 1e18. It is a prerequisite of the deposit, not a new grant.

findings.title: deposit: the label 'Deposit asset' sits on an amount, and the intent names neither asset nor vault.
findings.evidence: descriptor deposit field {path: assets, label: 'Deposit asset', format: tokenAmount}; intent 'Deposit'. The reader of case 0 could not say how many shares would arrive.
findings.fix: Label it 'Amount to deposit' and use the intent 'Deposit EURCV into MEV Capital vault'.

cases.notes: EURCV out matches 1 EURCV. sgfEURCV in is shown only by ticker and receiver, with no amount. The allowance spend is not shown.

effects: The signer sends EURCV to the vault. The amount is computed when the transaction runs: shares × (lastTotalAssets+1)/(totalSupply+10^offset), rounded up. There is no maximum. This spends the signer's EURCV allowance.
Exactly `shares` newly minted sgfEURCV go to `receiver`.
formats.shown: "Mint" with the ticker EURCV as 'Deposit asset' (no amount), the number of shares minted and the address that receives the shares.

findings.title: mint: the EURCV amount pulled from the signer is not shown and has no upper bound.
findings.evidence: MetaMorphoV1_1.sol mint(): assets = _convertToAssetsWithTotals(shares, totalSupply(), lastTotalAssets, Ceil); _deposit pulls `assets`. Case 0 of mint (case 1): 1002900046 wei EURCV left the signer, and the screen shows 'Deposit asset: EURCV' with no amount.
findings.fix: No descriptor fix. The amount comes from the share price in storage, and the ABI has no maxAssets parameter.

findings.title: mint: the intent 'Mint' does not say that EURCV leaves the wallet.
findings.evidence: descriptor mint intent 'Mint'. The only sign of the outflow is a raw field 'Deposit asset' = $.metadata.constants.underlyingTicker.
findings.fix: Use the intent 'Deposit EURCV for vault shares' and label the field 'Pay with (amount set by vault price)'.

formats.key: withdraw(uint256 assets, address receiver, address owner)
effects: sgfEURCV shares are burned from `owner`. The number is computed as assets × (totalSupply+10^offset)/(lastTotalAssets+1), rounded up. There is no maximum.
When the signer is not `owner`, the signer's share allowance from the owner is spent.
formats.shown: "Withdraw" with the exact EURCV amount, the receiver and the owner.

findings.title: withdraw: the number of shares burned from the owner is not shown and has no maximum.
findings.evidence: MetaMorphoV1_1.sol withdraw(): shares = _convertToSharesWithTotals(assets, ..., Ceil); ERC4626._withdraw burns `shares` from owner. Case 2: 29834730 sgfEURCV burned from the signer, and the screen has no share field.
findings.fix: No descriptor fix. The amount is derived from storage.

findings.title: withdraw: the label 'Owner' does not say that this account's shares are burned.
findings.evidence: descriptor withdraw field {path: owner, label: 'Owner'}. ERC4626._withdraw calls _spendAllowance(owner, caller, shares) when caller != owner, then _burn(owner, shares).

cases.notes: The share burn is not on screen. The reader inferred it but had no amount.

formats.key: redeem(uint256 shares, address receiver, address owner)
effects: Exactly `shares` sgfEURCV are burned from `owner`. When the signer is not `owner`, the signer's share allowance from the owner is spent.
EURCV is sent to `receiver`. The amount is computed as shares × (lastTotalAssets+1)/(totalSupply+10^offset), rounded down. There is no minimum.
formats.shown: "Redeem" with the number of shares, the receiver and the owner. The asset received is not named.

findings.title: redeem: the screen never names EURCV as the asset the receiver gets.
findings.evidence: descriptor redeem fields: shares, receiver, owner only, while mint names $.metadata.constants.underlyingTicker. Case 3: 17717.896968460255319581 EURCV arrived at the signer, and nothing on screen names EURCV. The reader wrote 'Which token is paid out; the screen doesn't name it'.
findings.fix: Add {"label": "Receive asset", "format": "raw", "value": "$.metadata.constants.underlyingTicker"} and use the intent 'Redeem vault shares for EURCV'.

findings.title: redeem: the EURCV amount received is not shown and has no minimum.
findings.evidence: MetaMorphoV1_1.sol redeem(): assets = _convertToAssetsWithTotals(shares, totalSupply(), lastTotalAssets, Floor). It takes no minAssets parameter.
findings.fix: No descriptor fix. The amount comes from storage.

findings.title: redeem: the label 'Owner' does not say that this account's shares are burned.
findings.evidence: descriptor redeem field {path: owner, label: 'Owner'}. ERC4626._withdraw burns from owner and spends the caller's allowance.

cases.notes: Shares out are shown exactly. EURCV in is neither named nor given an amount.
